messages.en:
Have you{01 00 00 05 00} ever found a
{ff 00 00 07}{07 0b 00}message in a bottle{ff 00 00 00}?{02 01 00 09 0a 0b}
What's that?
Oh yeah!
Not yet.
messages.et:
Kas sa oled{01 00 00 05 00} kunagi leidnud
{ff 00 00 07}{07 0b 00}sõnumi pudelis{ff 00 00 00}?{02 01 00 09 0a 0b}
Mis see on?
Oh jaa!
Veel mitte.

messages.en:
{07 19 00}In the afternoon, the beach
is a place for the kiddies,
{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}.{01 00 00 14 00}
That's not the time for old
people to be there.

What? Whaddya lookin' at,
{04 02 00}?!
messages.et:
{07 19 00}Pärastlõunal on rand
lastele mõeldud koht,
{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}.{01 00 00 14 00}
See pole aeg, mil vanad
inimesed seal käiksid.

Mis? Mida sa vahid,
{04 02 00}?!

messages.en:
{07 14 00}This is my favorite time of
day to be at the beach,
{04 02 00}.
{07 00 00}It's so bleak and devoid
of all joy.

{07 19 00}It kinda reminds me of 
myself on my better days{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.
messages.et:
{07 14 00}See on mu lemmikaeg
rannas olemiseks,
{04 02 00}.
{07 00 00}See on nii sünge ja
rõõmust tühi.

{07 19 00}See meenutab mulle mind 
mu paremail päevil{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.

messages.en:
{07 19 00}The beach at night is 
kinda like me, huh?{01 00 00 14 00}{02 00 00 07 08}
Exactly!
What part?
messages.et:
{07 19 00}Rand öösel on omamoodi 
nagu mina, mis?{01 00 00 14 00}{02 00 00 07 08}
Täpselt!
Mis osa?

messages.en:
{07 00 00}You don't see it?{01 00 00 05 00}
The sea's dangerous...
I'm dangerous, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}.
{07 15 00}Guess that means you don't
really know me,{01 00 00 0f 00} doesn't it,
{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}?!

{07 14 00}Heh heh,{01 00 00 0f 00} you're even dumber
than you look, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}.

{07 00 00}A message in a bottle is
just a message.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}in a
bottle. {01 00 00 05 00}Imagine that!
messages.et:
{07 14 00}Heh heh,{01 00 00 0f 00} sa oled rumalam
kui välja näed, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}.

{07 00 00}Sõnum pudelis on lihtsalt
sõnum.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}pudelis.
{01 00 00 05 00}Kujuta ette!

messages.en:
{07 00 00}You know that spacey otter
who's always philosophizing?
{07 0b 00}Ever met him, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}?{02 00 00 0f 0f}
Yup!
Not yet.
messages.et:
{07 00 00}Tead seda hajameelset
saarmast-filosoofi?
{07 0b 00}Kas kohtasid, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}?{02 00 00 0f 0f}
Jah!
Veel mitte.

messages.en:
{07 15 00}Ha!{01 00 00 0f 00} On a rainy day like
this, it looks like the sea
is crying{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.
{07 17 00}Man, I must have sounded
pretty rad when I said that
just then. {0b 03 00}{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}?
messages.et:
{07 15 00}Ha!{01 00 00 0f 00} Sellisel vihmasel päeval
nagu täna paistab, et meri
nutab{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.
{07 17 00}Poiss, ma pidin kõlama
päris ägedalt, kui ma seda
praegu ütlesin. {0b 03 00}{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}?

messages.en:
{07 00 00}Even on a cold day like 
today, the sea doesn't 
freeze, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}.
{07 15 00}It's enormous.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 14 00} Why can't I
be as awesome as the
ocean?
messages.et:
{07 00 00}Isegi nii külmal päeval 
täna meri ei külmu, 
{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}.
{07 15 00}See on tohutu.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 14 00} Miks ei või
mina olla nii vinge kui
ookean?

messages.en:
{07 00 00}Can you believe I don't 
even hate that dude, 
{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}.
messages.et:
{07 00 00}Kas sa suudad uskuda, et 
ma ei vihka seda tüüpi, 
{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}.

messages.en:
{07 00 00}Really?{01 01 00} I thought that guy
was just your average
otter until one day...
...a stray soccer ball
beaned him in the head!

After that, he turned into
this deep-thinking 
philosopher, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
messages.et:
{07 00 00}Tõesti?{01 01 00} Ma arvasin, et see
tüüp on lihtsalt tavaline
saarmas, kuni ühel päeval...
...eksinud jalgpall
virutas talle vastu pead!

Pärast seda muutus ta
sügavalt mõtlevaks 
filosoofiks, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!

messages.en:
{07 00 00}Really, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}?!{01 00 00 14 00} 
I heard he combs the beach
for rare stuff.
Can you believe some of it
just ends up washed up on
the beach?
messages.et:
{07 00 00}Tõesti, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}?!{01 00 00 14 00} 
Kuulsin, et ta kammib randa
haruldaste asjade järele.
Kas suudad uskuda, et osa
sellest lihtsalt uhutakse
randa?
